description: Rare surviving Tu-124. c/n 4351408. Acquired for the park aviation pavilion; recorded on site 2023.
Delivered to the museum on 3 December 2021, bought from the Sukhoi corporation. Carries 88179 without the RA- prefix as photographed. c/n 9621947.
Cabin section only. Also wears the number 23. c/n 548146053.
